luci-app-netbird-health-read.description: Read cached NetBird health results and non-secret approved configuration

luci-app-netbird-health-run.description: Request one coalesced approved NetBird health baseline check

luci-app-netbird-health-config.description: Change only revision-checked independent NetBird health configuration

luci-app-netbird-health-export.description: Create and retrieve bounded redacted NetBird health evidence exports

luci-app-netbird-health-notify.description: Submit one explicit bounded test to the protected locally owned notification sink

luci-app-netbird-health-recover.description: Confirm and query one audited managed NetBird restart; distinct from read-only checks

luci-app-netbird-health-automatic.description: Explicitly authorize or revoke bounded automatic recovery independently of health settings
